name: Ephraim
overview: Ephraim, the second son of Joseph, was divinely blessed to be fruitful in the land of affliction, as his name signifies (Genesis 41:52). Adopted by Jacob as his own son, Ephraim was favored above his older brother Manasseh, receiving the primary blessing despite birth order (Genesis 48:5, 14). The tribe of Ephraim was significant in Israel, numbered at over forty thousand men at Mount Sinai (Numbers 1:33), and was the recipient of God's abundant blessings through the God of their father. These blessings underscored Ephraim's unique position among the tribes, being set apart and crowned with favor (Genesis 49:25-26).
